title: Develop with Solar Network 2026
description: Build innovative projects using Solar Network's capabilities. Any programming language, any form — showcase your creativity alongside the Solar Network platform.
shortDescription: A summer 2026 special event. Build with Solar Network, show your skills.
rules: Any project form (hardware, software, website, etc.) is accepted
No limit on team members (only one prize set will be provided)
Must use at least one capability of Solar Network
Building a third-party Solar Network client is discouraged (low creativity score)
